verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit has a built-in AI assistant (@coderabbitai) that users can delegate work to. Users can chat with it about a PR, prompt it to generate its own improvements, and trigger one-click agentic actions to fix findings, resolve merge conflicts, generate unit tests, simplify code or run custom recipes. A Slack agent also handles investigation, planning and code editing, and Coding Plans can be handed off to other coding agents. Community comments corroborate that it writes tests and offers committable fixes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports confirming how reliable and deep the delegated agentic tasks (e.g. merge-conflict resolution, Slack code editing) are in practice.
